slides.headline: Your new tenant doesn't exist.
slides.body: Flawless credit. Flawless background. Pristine pay stubs. But they are completely fabricated by AI. Swipe to see how.

slides.headline: Welcome to the era of Synthetic Identity Fraud.
slides.body: Generative AI can now stitch a real stolen SSN to a fake name, synthesize a credit profile, and render fake income docs in 4 seconds.

slides.headline: Traditional software is built to screen humans.
slides.body: Your team checks the credit report, celebrates the 'perfect' score, and signs the lease. You are playing checkers; they are playing chess.

slides.headline: Three months later, the rent stops.
slides.body: The fake identity vanishes. You spend 6 months in housing court and pay $15,000 in eviction and unit-turn costs. All for a ghost.

slides.headline: Aethera treats leasing as a cybersecurity event.
slides.body: We don't trust a PDF of an ID. Aethera cross-references biometric identity graphs with live banking ledgers before a lease is ever generated.

slides.headline: The system catches the fraud before you sign.
slides.body: If a pay stub's metadata has been manipulated or doesn't match the applicant's digital ledger, the lease creation is blocked automatically.

slides.headline: Stop fighting 2026 AI fraud with 2018 screening tools.
slides.body: Put a cybersecurity shield over your leasing pipeline. Secure your portfolio's yield before the ghost moves in.
